Farewell, Nylon Palace!

Back to quest database

A descriptive entry for the roof-building objective because the exact tracker title is not retained.

Recorded build reference · 0.8.10.842 · configuration record, not individually play-tested

Work through the objectives

  1. Craft and place a storage chest.
  2. Build at least nine house foundations.
  3. Build at least nine standard exterior wall sections.
  4. Build at least two window-wall sections.
  5. Install two windows, in addition to the window walls.
  6. Build an exterior wall section with a doorway.
  7. Install the door itself.
  8. Build a doorstep.
  9. Complete the roof.
  10. Craft and place a bed.

Checks that can cause a stop

  • Window walls and windows have separate checks, as do doorway walls and doors. Check for missing pieces before using the roof-tracker recovery guide.
Failure conditions, recovery & continuation
Failure trigger
No quest-level failure trigger recorded
After failure
Restarts the current quest
After success
Starts a configured follow-up call

Roof objective with no named predecessor or successor retained. · Back to the quest directory record

Sources and boundary

  • Official support confirmed a known state where the roof objective is built but its tracker does not advance. Official

    Source: Steam thread: roof tracker known issue and support sequence · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • The official recovery sequence is to inspect the phone quest journal with T, sleep to the next day and restart the client if the tracker remains stuck. Official

    Source: Steam thread: roof tracker known issue and support sequence · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • Separate community cases involve hidden workbench rows, missing door/window placement or a Roof Cap opening; use the decision guide instead of treating every symptom as the tracker bug. Community-confirmed

    Source: August 2026 roof-building discussion scan · local archive · Build: 0.8.10.x

These steps come from the recorded game build and public sources; missing rewards, prerequisites and unlock timing are not filled in.
